article_title: Raye wins the Mercury Prize with This Music May Contain Hope

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: The history of every Mercury Prize winner since 1992
Raye winning the 2026 Mercury Prize for her second album and the story behind the record
Olivia Dean preparing to release her first album
A campaign to replace the Mercury Prize with the Brit Awards
tasks.correct_answer: Raye winning the 2026 Mercury Prize for her second album and the story behind the record
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מדווחת על זכייתה של Raye ומסבירה את סגנון האלבום, תהליך יצירתו ומשמעות הפרס.

tasks.prompt: What prize did Raye receive along with the Mercury trophy?
options: A recording contract with Al Green
A Grammy nomination
Funding for 100 musicians
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האלבום זכה בפרס Mercury, הכולל סכום של 25,000 ליש״ט.

tasks.prompt: What does “cookie-cutter” mean when Raye says she did not make the album that way?
options: Recorded entirely in a kitchen
Short enough for radio playlists
Standardised and made to follow a familiar commercial formula
Written by several anonymous musicians
tasks.correct_answer: Standardised and made to follow a familiar commercial formula
tasks.explanation_hebrew: cookie-cutter מתאר יצירה אחידה וצפויה שמותאמת לתבנית מסחרית; Raye הדגישה שפעלה אחרת.

tasks.prompt: What delayed work on the album by almost a year?
options: The Mercury ceremony moved to Newcastle.
Raye changed all 17 tracks after a review.
One of the orchestras cancelled its recordings.
Her car was stolen with her songwriting notebooks and demos inside.
tasks.correct_answer: Her car was stolen with her songwriting notebooks and demos inside.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: גניבת המכונית, שבה היו מחברות הכתיבה והדמואים שלה, עיכבה את העבודה כמעט בשנה.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article present Raye's win as unusual in recent Mercury Prize history?
options: A pop album had not won the prize since M People's victory in 1994.
The prize normally accepts only debut albums.
No album longer than one hour had ever been nominated.
The judges usually exclude records that reach number one.
tasks.correct_answer: A pop album had not won the prize since M People's victory in 1994.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שזהו אלבום הפופ הראשון שזוכה מאז 1994, ולכן הזכייה בולטת בהיסטוריה העדכנית של הפרס.

tasks.prompt: What does “antidote” mean in the description of the Mercury Prize as an antidote to the Brit Awards?
options: A medical treatment for performers
A copy of a more commercial awards show
A contrasting alternative to a commercially focused prize
A requirement that winners donate their money
tasks.correct_answer: A contrasting alternative to a commercially focused prize
tasks.explanation_hebrew: antidote משמש כאן בהשאלה לחלופה מתקנת: פרס שמדגיש חדשנות מוזיקלית ולא אופנה או הצלחה מסחרית.

tasks.prompt: Give three details that show the large scale or cinematic style of This Music May Contain Hope.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה פרטים קונקרטיים מהכתבה המדגימים את היקף ההפקה או את המבנה הסיפורי.
expected_points: The album contains 17 tracks and lasts 73 minutes.
Some individual songs are seven minutes long.
It tells a cinematic story about a relationship, heartbreak in Paris and recovery.
It includes four orchestras and more than 100 musicians.
It features Raye's grandparents and soul singer Al Green.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the path from the album's difficult beginning to its Mercury Prize victory.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את הגניבה והעיכוב, את יצירת האלבום ללא התמקדות בהצלחה מסחרית, את קבלתו ולבסוף את הזכייה.
expected_points: Raye's car was stolen with notebooks and demos, delaying the album by almost a year.
She created an ambitious, maximalist record without following a commercial formula.
The album topped the UK chart and received strong reviews after its March release.
It beat nominees including Paul McCartney, Olivia Dean and Jade to win the 2026 Mercury Prize.

tasks.prompt: How does Raye's reaction to the theft support the album's theme of resilience?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין קבלת האירוע בדיעבד לבין סיפור האלבום על התאוששות והתחזקות לאחר משבר.
expected_points: She said the theft initially left her distraught and worried.
She later viewed slips and accidents as events that shape a person's path.
The album's heroine recovers after a relationship ends and emerges stronger.
Both the real experience and the album narrative turn disruption into growth rather than defeat.

tasks.prompt: Write a short music review using the words “maximalist”, “resilient” and “shortlist”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בשלושת המונחים במדויק, לתאר את האלבום באופן נאמן לכתבה ולהבחין בין עובדה לדעה.
expected_points: Use all three required terms accurately.
Mention the album's large-scale sound or long, indulgent songs.
Connect resilience to the album's story of recovering from heartbreak.
State that it won after appearing on a shortlist with other named or varied artists.
